structs.name: ke_transform_component
structs.doc: Per-entity 3D transform component. Read/written as one atomic unit (position, rotation, and scale are meaningless set independently mid-write) — kabic's [whole:] tag maps the whole struct to a single bit-cast property instead of one property per field. world_matrix is derived output, recomputed from the hierarchy each frame; it rides along in the same atomic struct rather than being a separate field a caller could plausibly author.

structs.name: ke_audio_player_component
structs.doc: A single audio clip, loaded from the path the scene declares and played on demand. The clip is one node's, not one system's: two AudioPlayer children under the same parent are two clips, told apart by node name.

fields.name: path
fields.doc: Path to the audio file, resolved against the project's base directory.
